description: Casa Bonay is a boutique hotel at Gran Via de les Corts Catalanes 700, in the Eixample. The address sits up the grid from the Gothic Quarter, which is often where Barcelona hotels start to feel like a design magazine and the rate becomes a moving target. The rate printed here is the Standard Double Room Booking.com showed for two adults on 10–11 November 2026, including the discount that was on the listing that day.
